row.proto: void *Vm_ValueNode_Construct_String(void *node, void *allocator, uint8_t flags, uint32_t *name_hash, void **str)
row.notes: Constructs a VM value node in place (vtable 0x145661200, +0x20 name hash, +0x26 flag bits, +0x24 refcount=1, +0x38 allocator) and allocates a 0x10-byte value holder (vtable 0x145662370) that add-refs and stores the NeStr *str, saved at node+0x58. Same post-checks as the NodeRef variant (float type 0x14612bbe0 gets 1.0 if invalid, type 0x146ca7550 sets bit 2 of node+0x60) but no dirty mark. Hook point to see every string node created in the UI data model.
